query_snapshot: For hydrogen peroxide solution from 30 to 70 percent, which barriers does the archived NIOSH table place in its 8-hour group and which in its 4-hour group?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- The archived NIOSH table places the following barriers for hydrogen peroxide solution (30%–70%) in the 8-hour group: Butyl; Natural (rubber); Nitrile (rubber); PE; Viton; CPF3; Responder; Tychem. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective ...: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- The archived NIOSH table places the following barriers for hydrogen peroxide solution (30%–70%) in the 4-hour group: PVC; PE/EVAL. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective ...: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
